reasoning: Both work: each has a correct Charm signal, uses listen in PlacementPreview, and removes the event. B converts the signal to Vide state in the app() body inside mount and leaves BlockPicker as a pure view fed a Vide source. A moves useSignalState into BlockPicker, which changes its prop contract so it needs a Charm getter (a Vide source passed by a story would stop updating), and it renames the getter. B is the cleaner, more faithful change.

criteria.criterion: BlockPlacer owns selection as Charm signal
criteria.note: `Charm.signal` with the setter kept private, exposed as `BlockPlacer.selectedBlockType`; `setBlockType` still asserts the name before calling `setSelected`.

criteria.criterion: Hotbar converts Charm to Vide state in mounted scope
criteria.note: `useSignalState(props.Selected)` is called in the BlockPicker body, which runs inside `mount` via `app()`, so it works and is cleaned up; the conversion just lives in the view instead of the caller.

criteria.criterion: Single copy of selection, BlockTypeChanged removed
criteria.note: Removes the BindableEvent, the event field and the copy in Main.client.luau; `placeAt` reads `getSelected()`.
`Charm.listen(BlockPlacer.selectedBlockType, applyBlockType)` colors the ghost right away and on every change.
BlockPicker now requires VideCharm, and `Selected` must be a Charm getter, so callers that pass a Vide source (stories) would see only the first value and never update.
All checks pass and it works, but renaming `getBlockType` to `selectedBlockType` changes the public API more than needed.

criteria.criterion: BlockPlacer owns selection as Charm signal
criteria.note: `getBlockType = getSelectedName`, with the setter kept local; `setBlockType` asserts the name, then calls `setSelectedName`.

criteria.criterion: Hotbar converts Charm to Vide state in mounted scope
criteria.note: `VideCharm.useSignalState(BlockPlacer.getBlockType)` is in the `app()` body passed to `mount`, so Vide tracks it and it is disposed with the UI.

criteria.criterion: Single copy of selection, BlockTypeChanged removed
criteria.note: BindableEvent and the copied source removed; `placeAt` uses `getSelectedName()`.
`Charm.listen(BlockPlacer.getBlockType, applyBlockType)`, with a comment noting the immediate first call.
BlockPicker is untouched and still receives a Vide source from Main.
Minimal, focused diff; the existing `getBlockType` name is kept and all checks pass.

listen colors the ghost at start
